name: workflow
description: Spec-driven delivery pipeline: /spec (PRD) -> /taskplan (partitioned plan) -> /implement (parallel orchestrated build; /implement-orca for Orca-dispatched workers) -> /cleanup (PR, CI, merge, teardown). Plus /frontier for ticket-level parallelism over GitHub Issues (one Orca worktree per ticket), and /project-kit project scaffolding.
